results.title: RHGH leader, Ngoforo, tackles Atiku over ‘politics of foreign interference’ call
results.description: Deputy National Leader (Southeast) of the Renewed Hope for Greater Nigeria (RHGN), Franklin Ngoforo, has called on Nigerians to reject what he described as former Vice President Atiku Abubakar’s “politics of external interference” and rally behind President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election. The post RHGH leader, Ngoforo, tackles Atiku over ‘politics of foreign interference’ call appeared first on The Sun Nigeria .

results.title: Workers can refuse to work during severe weather occurrences without facing sanctions, DOLE reminds Philippine employers
results.description: New labour guidelines protect private-sector employees from administrative sanctions when severe weather poses an imminent danger, but those who stay home may not be entitled to regular pay.
